dish.title: Italian Grilled Calamari with Tomato-Caper Salad and Grilled Bread
dish.description: Cleaned squid tubes and tentacles marinated briefly in olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, and chile flakes, grilled fast over high heat until tender and lightly charred, and tossed with a salad of cherry tomatoes, capers, red onion, parsley, and arugula. Served with grilled garlic bread.

recipe_version.title: Italian Grilled Calamari with Tomato-Caper Salad and Grilled Bread
recipe_version.description: Cleaned squid tubes and tentacles marinated briefly in olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, and chile flakes, grilled fast over high heat until tender and lightly charred, and tossed with a salad of cherry tomatoes, capers, red onion, parsley, and arugula. Served with grilled garlic bread.

ingredients.name: cleaned squid tubes and tentacles
ingredients.preparation: tubes scored lightly on one side, patted very dry

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 3 tbsp squid, 3 tbsp salad, 2 tbsp bread

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: 2 grated for the squid, 2 halved for rubbing the bread

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.note: zest of 1 for the squid; juice of 1 for the salad

ingredients.name: crusty bread
ingredients.display_name: crusty bread whose label lists no milk, butter, egg, soy, or sesame

steps.title: Prep the squid
steps.body: Pat the squid very dry. Score the tubes lightly in a crosshatch on one side. Grate 2 garlic cloves and zest 1 lemon, then toss the squid with 3 tbsp olive oil, the grated garlic, zest, chile flakes, and 1 tsp salt.

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.body: Preheat the grill on high, lid closed, for 10 minutes, then clean and oil the grate.

steps.title: Make the salad and marinate
steps.body: While the grill heats and the squid marinates, halve the tomatoes, rinse the capers, slice the onion, and toss them with the parsley, the juice of the second lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp salt. Halve the last 2 garlic cloves and slice the bread (overlap stated).

steps.title: Grill the bread
steps.body: Brush the bread with 2 tbsp olive oil and grill until marked, about 1 minute per side. Rub the hot slices with the cut garlic.

steps.title: Grill the squid
steps.body: Grill the tubes scored side down and the tentacles in a grill basket until opaque and lightly charred, 1 to 2 minutes per side. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.body: Slice the tubes into thick rings and toss with the tentacles, the tomato salad, and the arugula. Serve at once with the garlic bread.

equipment: grill basket or perforated grill pan for tentacles
